segments.title: Station Cold-Open: Pepito Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official Grunchmas sign-on from the control room, identifying as the dog producer and president of the 'one who flocks every crust man.'

segments.title: Grunchmas Introduction
segments.notes: Case Blackwell debuts as The Grunch — a horny green Grinch variant — explaining his annual emergence from an amniotic sack for a week-long procreative orgy.

segments.title: Hype Train Summoning & Subscriber Roll
segments.notes: Grunch summons Hype Train to the scrying cave; Hype Train hits level 10 hype with a Christmas trap beat freestyle while processing a massive sub influx including 5 community subs from Cycorp and 300 bits from S.K.O.A.M.Y.R.

segments.title: Munch Interrupts Grunchmas
segments.notes: Munch briefly hijacks the broadcast claiming a spiritual retreat in Jacksonville, Florida, declares 'Mary fucks miss,' and sings a truncated 'O Holy Night' before departing.

segments.title: The Fucks List Adjudication
segments.notes: Grunch works through the community Discord submissions deciding who 'fucks' — covering internet personalities, fictional characters, and public figures with absurdist rationale — punctuated by beat changes and musical interludes.

segments.title: Grunch vs Crum Debate: Does Crum Fuck?
segments.notes: Crum appears with glowing radioactive hair; Grunch argues affirmatively while Crum rhetorically withholds, culminating in Crum revealing a daily scheduled marital intimacy regimen managed via locked chore calendar.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Gift Wrapping Tutorial
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget summoned to scrying cave; learns to wrap a candle for a Starbucks barista while confirming his father is purely a wooden construct with no human remains.

segments.title: Fucks List Speed Round
segments.notes: Grunch rapid-fires through remaining entries in rhyming cadence over struggling beats, covering dozens of names in a final sprint to close the list.

segments.title: Kendall's Grunk-Miss Wish: Popular (Pink Grunch)
segments.notes: Grunch saturates himself pink to fulfill Kendelle's second wish, performing 'Popular' from Wicked with Kendelle briefly appearing on camera.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Grunch thanks subscribers, announces return to regular BIN scheduling, and raids Miss Fire O3 while overlooking the uninviting Whoville orgy from his mountaintop cave.

lore_notes.fact: The Grunch emerges annually from an amniotic sack as an amoeba, rapidly growing to full size and immediately entering a procreative state; he self-clones and considers himself immortal despite dying yearly.
The Grunch's heart is a genital that grows six sizes during the season.
The Grunch's physical form shrank slightly this year, reducing operating room in the Grunchmas cave.
Munch claims a months-long spiritual retreat in Jacksonville, Florida, where he concluded he was 'right' all along.
Crum now possesses a full head of glowing radioactive hair, a departure from his canonical bald pate.
Crum and his wife Belulia maintain a locked chore calendar that schedules daily sexual activity, using water-based lubricant when needed.
Jeb's father is confirmed as entirely wooden with no human tissue remaining, trapped in a board.
Jeb regularly gifts candles to a specific Starbucks barista (Jessica) who works a Tuesdays/Thursdays off schedule he finds suspicious.

episode_summary: The Grunchmas 2024 special sees anchor Case Blackwell embody the horny green 'Grunch' for a week-long annual broadcast event, processing a record subscriber haul with Hype Train before adjudicating the community-submitted 'Fucks List' of internet personalities and fictional characters. The broadcast features a surprise Munch & Crum debate on Crum's sexual activity, a How To with Jeb gift-wrapping tutorial, and concludes with Grunch fulfilling Kendelle's wish to turn pink and sing 'Popular' from Wicked before raiding out.
